You're All Set!

You can now use VIRN to organize your subjects and lessons, generate AI-powered reviewers, take practice quizzes, track deadlines on your calendar, manage your weekly schedule, and keep on top of your to-do list — all synced and ready whenever you open the app.

Terms & Conditions

Last updated: July 2026

1. Acceptance of these Terms

By creating an account or using VIRN ("the app"), you agree to these Terms & Conditions. If you don't agree, please don't use the app.

2. What VIRN is

VIRN is a personal study notebook. It lets you organize subjects, terms, and lessons, take notes, generate quizzes and reviewers, and export your notes as documents. Some features use Google's Gemini AI to generate summaries, quizzes, and reviewers from content you provide.

3. Your account

You're responsible for keeping your login credentials private and for all activity under your account. Use accurate information when signing up. One account per person — don't share your account with others.

4. Your content

Your notes, uploaded files, and anything else you add to VIRN remain yours. By using the AI features (Summarize, Generate Quiz, Generate Reviewer, and document extraction), you agree that this content is sent to Google's Gemini API for processing in order to generate that feature's output.

5. AI-generated content isn't guaranteed to be accurate

Summaries, quizzes, and reviewers generated by AI may contain mistakes, omissions, or oversimplifications. Always double-check AI-generated material against your original notes or a teacher before relying on it for an actual exam.

6. Acceptable use

Don't use VIRN to store or generate illegal, abusive, or harmful content, to try to break or abuse the app or its AI features, or to access another user's account without permission.

7. Administrator access

VIRN's administrator ([email protected]) can open an internal Admin Panel that lists registered accounts and how much storage each account's notes, calendar, schedule, to-do items, and reviewers are using. From there, the administrator can open a read-only view of that content for support, troubleshooting, deletion, and moderation purposes. The Admin Panel cannot edit, or add anything to your account — it is view-only. This access is limited to the administrator account and is not shared with anyone else.

8. Availability

VIRN is provided as-is. Features may change, break, or be unavailable from time to time, and we don't guarantee uninterrupted access.

9. Termination

We may suspend or remove accounts that violate these terms. You can stop using VIRN and ask for your account to be deleted at any time.

10. Changes to these terms

These terms may be updated occasionally. Continuing to use VIRN after a change means you accept the updated terms.

11. Limitation of liability

VIRN is offered without warranties of any kind. To the extent allowed by law, we aren't liable for any loss of data or damages arising from your use of the app.

12. Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of the Philippines, unless otherwise required by where you live.

13. Contact

Questions about these terms? Reach out at [email protected].

Account settings

AI key & models

Works with Google AI Studio (AIza…) or OpenRouter (sk-or-v1-…) keys — VIRN detects which one you pasted automatically. Get a free Google key from Google AI Studio or an OpenRouter key from openrouter.ai/keys.

Paste once, done forever: your key is saved on this device and backed up to your VIRN account. Even if you clear your browser data or switch devices, it comes back automatically after you sign in — you'll never have to paste it again.

Delete account

Permanently deletes your account and everything in it — every subject, note, quiz, calendar entry, schedule, to-do, and reviewer. This cannot be undone.

Promote to next grade

This archives the current grade level as a read-only archive — its notes and quizzes stay saved, nothing is deleted — and starts a brand-new, empty workspace for the next grade level.

Sets the new grade level's school year — the Promote/Graduate/Move Up button stays locked until the End date arrives.
